captureMethod: Public web reader (including cached pages, crawled between today and last month); producer Arabic names and published KWD prices, English image alt labels. English language link returned Arabic content. Prices are observed public listings, not a live quote.

exclusions: Five oil and eight biscuit family pages exposed no public sellable cards (not proof of no inventory).
Ice Cream/Chocolate Biscuits family page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Animal feed Shuar 50 kg bag at 4.750 KWD is outside the food demo scope; separate animal-feed storefront linked.
No login/CAPTCHA, authenticated inventory, supplier PDFs, or alternate storefronts reviewed.
accessFailures: Executor curl: (7) Failed to connect to proxy port 8080; used public web connector.
Transient web HTTP 403/timeouts on some family pages; later public cached reads succeeded except s=95897.
English ChangeLanguage link redirects to Arabic content in the stateless reader.
